sellingPoints: Large paper capacity up to 2,300 sheets
competitiveAdvantages: Lower cost per page than competitors

unboxing: Remove all packing materials and protective tape
Remove the imaging drum shipping lock
initialSetup: Select language and region on control panel
Install paper in all required trays

ethernet: Connect RJ-45 cable to the network port
On control panel, navigate to Setup > Network > Wired (Ethernet)
Configure IP settings (DHCP or Static IP)
Print network configuration page to verify
Access EWS at http://[printer-ip] to complete setup
wifi: Requires optional HP Jetdirect 3000w NFC/Wireless Accessory
Install the wireless accessory in the device
Navigate to Setup > Network > Wireless on control panel
Select your network SSID and enter password
Confirm connection and print network config page

driverInstallation.windows: Download HP Universal Print Driver from hp.com/support or use HP Easy Start installer. Follow on-screen prompts to complete installation.
driverInstallation.mac: Download HP Printer Drivers for macOS from hp.com/support or use Apple Software Update. Add printer via System Preferences > Printers & Scanners.
driverInstallation.linux: Use HPLIP (HP Linux Imaging and Printing). Install via package manager or from hplipopensource.com. Run hp-setup command.

configPages.meterPage: Press and hold OK button for 5 seconds to print supplies status page showing page counts
configPages.configPage: Navigate to Reports menu on control panel > Configuration/Status Pages > Configuration Page
configPages.networkConfigPage: Reports menu > Configuration/Status Pages > Network Summary or Jetdirect Page
configPages.webInterface: Enter the printer's IP address in a web browser (e.g., http://192.168.1.100) to access the Embedded Web Server (EWS)

commonIssues: If network connection fails, verify DHCP is enabled on network or manually assign static IP
If print quality is poor after unboxing, run cleaning cycle from control panel
Update firmware via EWS after initial setup for best performance
Configure scan-to-email by setting up SMTP server in EWS > Scan/Digital Send > Email Setup

solutions: Turn printer off and back on
Clear all print jobs from queue
Update printer firmware to latest version
Ensure correct PCL6 or PS driver is installed
Check network cable connections
Open indicated access door and carefully remove jammed paper
Check paper quality and reload properly in tray
Inspect paper path for obstructions
Replace pickup roller kit if jams are frequent
Power cycle the printer
Check fuser page count (should be replaced at ~225k pages)
Replace fuser maintenance kit
If error persists, contact HP support for controller board diagnosis
Remove and reseat toner cartridge
Clean cartridge memory contacts with lint-free cloth
Replace with genuine HP toner cartridge
Update printer firmware

accessInstructions: Pull out Tray 2 completely from the device
Look for jammed paper at the back of the tray area
clearanceSteps: Gently pull out any jammed paper in the direction of paper path
Check for torn pieces of paper and remove completely
Reload paper correctly, ensuring guides are snug against paper stack
prevention: Use only paper within 60-256 g/m² specification
Do not overfill trays (max line indicator)
Fan paper before loading to prevent static

accessInstructions: Open the rear access door (labeled with red handle)
If fuser is hot, wait 20 minutes for cooling
clearanceSteps: Locate green release levers on fuser
Lift levers and gently pull paper straight out
Do not use sharp objects to remove paper
Check fuser for damage if jams recur
prevention: Avoid using damaged or wrinkled paper
Ensure fuser maintenance kit is replaced at rated interval
Do not print heavy cardstock beyond specifications

accessInstructions: Locate the duplex unit (two-sided printing path)
clearanceSteps: Press green release tabs on duplex unit
Push duplex unit back in until it clicks
prevention: Do not use pre-punched or heavily textured paper for duplex
Clean duplex rollers monthly in high-volume environments

solutions: Check toner level via control panel or EWS
Disable EconoMode in print driver settings
Remove toner cartridge, shake gently, and reinstall
Replace toner cartridge if at end of life
Run cleaning page from control panel

symptoms: Consistent black lines down the page
solutions: Print cleaning page from Reports menu
Inspect transfer roller for toner buildup and clean if needed
Check toner cartridge for leaks
Replace transfer roller if cleaning doesn't help
If issue persists, replace imaging drum
Verify correct paper type is selected in driver and control panel
Run fuser test from diagnostics menu
Update firmware to latest version
Replace fuser if at end of life (225k pages)
Ensure using paper within weight specifications

networkIssues.issue: Cannot connect to printer on network
diagnosticSteps: Print network configuration page from control panel
Verify IP address is on correct subnet
Check that Ethernet cable is securely connected
Test with different Ethernet cable and port
Verify network switch port is active
solutions: If using DHCP, check DHCP server has available addresses
Assign static IP address via control panel if DHCP fails
Disable any firewall blocking printer communication
Update Jetdirect firmware via EWS
Reset network settings to factory defaults and reconfigure

diagnosticSteps: Verify SMTP server address and port in EWS
Test SMTP server connectivity from another device
Review email send logs in EWS
solutions: In EWS, go to Scan/Digital Send > Email Setup
Configure SMTP gateway (e.g., smtp.gmail.com:587)
Enable SMTP authentication and enter credentials
For Office 365, use smtp.office365.com port 587 with TLS
Ensure firewall allows outbound SMTP traffic
Test by sending to internal email address first

procedure: Pull out old toner cartridge by handle
Rock cartridge gently 5-6 times to distribute toner
Insert cartridge until it clicks into place

generalMaintenance.frequency: Every 225,000 pages or when 'Replace Maintenance Kit' message appears
procedure: Order genuine HP maintenance kit F2G76A
Wait 30 minutes for fuser to cool completely
Open rear door and remove old fuser unit
Install new fuser unit from kit
Replace transfer roller and pickup rollers per kit instructions
Reset maintenance counter via control panel: Administration > Manage Supplies > Reset Supplies
Wipe rollers to remove dirt and debris
Run test scan to verify pickup
Go to hp.com/support and search for M527f firmware
In EWS, go to General > Firmware Update

firmware.updateProcedure: Access EWS > General > Firmware Update. Upload .rfu file from hp.com/support

extendedOptions: HP 3-year Next Business Day Onsite Support (U9LV4E)
HP Managed Print Services with supplies included
